title: valeriana wolgensis var. nitida
intro: Valeriana wolgensis var. nitida, commonly known as American valerian or valerian, is a variety of the Valeriana plant, which is a perennial flowering plant native to North America. The health benefits of American valerian include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of valerian root include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating insomnia, restlessness, and muscle cramps. The bioactive constituents of valerian root include valerenic acid, isovalerenic acid, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
